liu-xin.oneLineEn: Western Han–Xin classicist and bibliographer who advanced Old Text classicism and catalog systems.

liu-zongyuan.oneLineEn: Tang thinker-writer known for arguments on Heaven and humanity, fengjian, and political institutions.

liu-zongzhou.oneLineEn: Late Ming master and Jishan School founder known for shendu and sincerity cultivation.

luo-qinshun.oneLineEn: Ming Neo-Confucian; Knowledge Painfully Acquired treats li-qi and mind-nature while criticizing Wang Learning.
keywordsEn: li and qi as one thing

mahasi-sayadaw.oneLineEn: Leading Burmese vipassana teacher whose satipatthana practice and Mahasi method shaped global Theravada meditation.

mikhail-bakunin.oneLineEn: Leading Russian anarchist known for freedom, critique of the state, and collectivist political theory.

nikolai-berdyaev.oneLineEn: Silver Age religious philosopher centered on freedom, personhood, creativity, and resistance to slavery.

nikolai-chernyshevsky.oneLineEn: Russian materialist whose rational egoism, aesthetics of reality, and What Is to Be Done? shaped 19th-c. radicalism.

nikolai-fedorov.oneLineEn: Russian cosmism pioneer who, in Philosophy of the Common Task, joined human unity, science, and resurrection.

pavel-florensky.oneLineEn: Silver Age theologian-philosopher linking Orthodoxy, epistemology, and symbol in The Pillar and Ground of the Truth.
keywordsEn: The Pillar and Ground of the Truth

peter-kropotkin.oneLineEn: Russian anarchist communist who, in Mutual Aid, cast cooperation, evolution, and free community as political ethics.

pyotr-chaadaev.oneLineEn: 19th-c. Russian thinker whose Philosophical Letters sparked debate on Russia's historical mission and path.

ruan-yuan.oneLineEn: Qing classicist, official, and academic organizer; a major synthesizer of Qian-Jia evidential learning.

semyon-frank.oneLineEn: Russian religious philosopher joining metaphysics and social thought via all-unity, the Unfathomable, and intuitionism.

sergei-bulgakov.oneLineEn: Silver Age religious philosopher who moved from Marxism to sophiology and Godmanhood philosophy of religion.

shandao.oneLineEn: Tang Pure Land master who systematized ordinary-person rebirth and nembutsu in the Contemplation Sutra commentary.

shang-yang.oneLineEn: Warring States Legalist reformer and a pivotal figure in Qin's institutional transformation.

shao-yong.oneLineEn: Northern Song Neo-Confucian pioneer known for image-number cosmology and observing things.

sima-guang.oneLineEn: Northern Song historian-statesman known for the Comprehensive Mirror and theories of political order.
keywordsEn: Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government

sima-qian.oneLineEn: Western Han historian, author of Records of the Grand Historian, founding the biographic-annalistic standard.
keywordsEn: fathoming the boundary of Heaven and humanity
